CVE-2026-109618.title: PHP out-of-memory handling remote code execution
CVE-2026-109618.summary: Flaw in how PHP handles out-of-memory conditions during request processing. The CNA advisory states that all PHP installations serving web requests are potentially at risk. PLACEHOLDER: affected_versions below is UNKNOWN until confirmed against the authoritative PHP advisory / NVD entry -- do not treat 'UNKNOWN' as 'not vulnerable'.

CVE-2026-109619.title: PHP use-after-free leading to cross-request data exposure
CVE-2026-109619.summary: Use-after-free bug where data left behind by one web request can be accessed during another request, potentially leading to code execution. PLACEHOLDER: affected_versions below is UNKNOWN until confirmed against the authoritative PHP advisory / NVD entry -- do not treat 'UNKNOWN' as 'not vulnerable'.
